mechanism_verification.finding: Verified in the downloaded v2 PDF: greedy coreset per spatial location, union of neighboring location coresets within radius r, patch anomaly score as minimum L2 distance within that union, and image anomaly score as maximum patch score.
mechanism_verification.scope_note: The v2 PDF abstract and Section 5.5 qualify superiority to four protocols with meaningful signal; under geometric drift all evaluated methods are near chance. Do not substitute the older landing-page claim of outperforming methods on all five protocols.
